title: DotfilesDevPorts
description: Host ports for generated web and api. Loaders fall back to identity/generation/examples/ports.defaults.json when the operator file is absent. Do not put LAN hostnames or secrets in the committed defaults.

web.description: Vite / frontend published port (container and default host).

api.description: Express service published port (container and default host).

bind.description: Address containers publish on. Homelab LAN uses 0.0.0.0; local-only can use 127.0.0.1.
